'''Rendezvous point aurek''' was the retreating point for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] forces following their defeat at the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]] against the might of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Eternal Alliance]].
